messages:
Maya: Quick sync  SkylineCloud co-marketing is a go. Need marketplace card, 30s benchmark clip, webinar (30-40m), and one-pager. Who owns what?
Evan: Ill do marketplace copy and the one-pager. Will need the benchmark numbers and a hero screenshot. Target: copy draft by Tue 8/6.
Liu: Ill run the benchmark and produce a 30s highlight clip. Metrics to feature: median token latency, cost per 1k tokens, and p95 for the demo prompt set. Using batch=8, kv-cache on, int8. Deliver by 8/8.
Kara (Design): Ill make hero + 3 socials + webinar thumbnail. Uploading first comps to Figma by 8/7. Need partner logos and preferred color hex.
Maya: Webinar logistics  proposed Wed 8/14 @ 9am PT. Format: 25m demo + 10m Q&A. Gate recording behind a simple HubSpot form. Can ops-bot create a routing?
ops-bot: HubSpot form `skyline_market_inbound` created. Webhook test OK. Recommend routing to sales queue "integrations" with tag `skyline_launch`.
Evan: Routing note: add hidden field `utm_campaign=skyline_launch` and map to lead source. Also set auto-assign to Evan for 48h then round-robin.
Liu: Dev snippet for adding hidden utm fields (drop into landing page near form):
```
const utm = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('utm_campaign') || 'marketplace';
document.querySelector('[name=utm_campaign]').value = utm;
```
Maya: Legal check  demo must not include any customer PII. I pinged legal; they said theyll review the script by EOD Friday.
Kara (Design): Figma link uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/abc  @Maya leave feedback on the hero variants.
Maya: Owners & deadlines: Evan  marketplace + one-pager 8/6; Liu  benchmark + clip 8/8; Kara  design comps 8/7; Maya  webinar logistics + invites 8/9. Dry run with Skyline one week before the webinar. :white_check_mark:
